backup.production_rule: No table, column or function change: the migration only re-schedules three pg_cron jobs (finance-watch-daily, release-expired-holds-hourly, verify-meter-photo-daily) so each sends the x-cascade-cron-secret header read from Vault. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs). Read the three cron.job commands first (select jobname, schedule, command from cron.job where jobname in (...)) and confirm each body matches the migration; it keeps each job current schedule and carries its live Authorization header over, but writes the body itself.

forward_verification.name: vault_secret_present
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(length(decrypted_secret) > 0) from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'cascade_cron_shared_secret'

forward_verification.name: three_jobs_active_with_their_schedules
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 and bool_and(active) and bool_and(case jobname when 'finance-watch-daily' then schedule = '30 0 * * *' when 'release-expired-holds-hourly' then schedule = '20 * * * *' else schedule = '30 23 * * *' end) from cron.job where jobname in ('finance-watch-daily', 'release-expired-holds-hourly', 'verify-meter-photo-daily')

forward_verification.name: each_job_calls_its_function_and_sends_the_vault_secret
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 and bool_and(command like '%x-cascade-cron-secret%' and command like '%vault.decrypted_secrets%' and command like '%cascade_cron_shared_secret%' and command like '%/functions/v1/' || case jobname when 'finance-watch-daily' then 'finance-watch' when 'release-expired-holds-hourly' then 'release-expired-holds' else 'verify-meter-photo' end || chr(39) || '%') from cron.job where jobname in ('finance-watch-daily', 'release-expired-holds-hourly', 'verify-meter-photo-daily')

forward_verification.name: no_job_embeds_the_secret
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 and bool_and(command !~ 'x-cascade-cron-secret''\s*,\s*''[^(]') from cron.job where jobname in ('finance-watch-daily', 'release-expired-holds-hourly', 'verify-meter-photo-daily')

forward_verification.name: meter_sweep_keeps_body_timeout_and_anon_jwt
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(command like '%"lookback":14%' and command like '%"notify":false%' and command like '%timeout_milliseconds := 300000%' and command like '%Bearer eyJ%') from cron.job where jobname = 'verify-meter-photo-daily'

steps.name: redeploy_previous_functions
steps.action: Normal rollback: redeploy the previous finance-watch, release-expired-holds and verify-meter-photo versions. An old function ignores the extra header, so the cron wiring can stay.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: Only if the jobs themselves must revert: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261007_cron_secret_three_jobs.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh. It restores the pre-G8 commands (no secret header); with the NEW functions deployed those jobs then get 401, so redeploy the old functions first.

feature_flags.name: sql_then_function
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this release FIRST, then deploy finance-watch, release-expired-holds and verify-meter-photo from waves commit c71d604 (s74/g8-cronauth). Deploy flags unchanged: finance-watch and release-expired-holds without JWT verification, verify-meter-photo WITH JWT verification (its job keeps the anon Authorization). CASCADE_CRON_SHARED_SECRET must already be set on the project (power-watch, system-verifier and expire-cleaning-photos read it). After deploy, read-only: POST each function with no header and expect 401, then run each job once from SQL (net.http_post with the Vault secret) and expect 200 and a fresh job_heartbeats row.

compatibility.rehearsal: NOT RUN (lane G8 has no Postgres here). Orchestrator: restore the newest backup into a rehearsal copy and apply the migration (1/1; the cron block skips there because pg_cron, pg_net and vault are absent), then run pgTAP cron_secret_three_jobs (12 tests, all skipped without pg_cron). The cron wiring itself can only be proven by the forward checks on production.
compatibility.evidence: Callers grepped across waves, stay-site, CH-Cleaners-Checklist, cleaners-main, staff-app, admin-dashboard, direct-booking, guest-guide, manual, system-guide (2026-10-07): the only caller of each function is its own pg_cron job (finance-watch-daily 30 0 * * *, release-expired-holds-hourly 20 * * * *, verify-meter-photo-daily 30 23 * * *); no browser, Apps Script, Telegram button, n8n or other edge function calls them. Cron commands taken from migration 20260913160000 (via the daily-digest job), sql/2026-09-16-session26-release-expired-holds-cron.sql and CH-Cleaners-Checklist/sql/2026-09-13d-cron-verify-meter-photo.sql; production not read by this lane.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
restore_point or verified_at is still empty or still the PENDING placeholder
the rehearsal has not applied the migration on this commit
the vault secret cascade_cron_shared_secret is missing or CASCADE_CRON_SHARED_SECRET is not set on the Edge project
